column1: # Cp.30 = "Vargas Mexia's Cipher 3" letter/syllable table, as used in BnF Espagnol 132 (1578-80).
# Source: S. Tomokiyo, Cryptiana, spanish3.htm image "cp30.png" (Spanish Cipher Cp.30), fetched 3 Oct 2026 from
#   cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/cp30.png; Tomokiyo cites Devos (1950) Cp.30 and Alcocer (1921) pp.628-640.
# One correction from el-descifrador/cabinet-noir es132-vargas-mexia/cle/cp30_complements.tsv (CC BY 4.0, 2 Oct 2026):
#   35 = pr (PROUVE-CTX there; Tomokiyo's table prints 35 under pl); 35_ (underlined) = pl. Credit: cabinet-noir.
# The nomenclature (word codes, numbers >= 38, cursive {words}) is NOT in this file: not on disk. Those tokens decode to [code].
# Vowel indicators after the base: + a, . e, σ i, ρ o, ⊣ u. Marks above the base: @l l, @m m, @n n, @r r, @s s.
